text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As May arrived,
a buzz of anticipation filled the racing world.

text_block_list.name: Racing Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Isn't this year's Japanese Derby totally crazy?
Way too many top-tier Umamusume are lining up!

text_block_list.name: Racing Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Like that girl who went undefeated across four wins and snagged a GII,
or the one who set the Japanese mile record.
And above all else—

text_block_list.name: Racing Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Gotta be Victoire Pisa!
I mean, look at how insane her run's been so far!

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: "At the Japanese Derby, I want to forge an even greater ring. A circle of fervor vast enough to unite the entire stands...!"

text_block_list.name: Racing Fan A
text_block_list.text:
And then we have Rose Kingdom! Having achieved a long-sought
GⅠ victory in the Asahi Hai FS, the reigning Junior Class champion!

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: "At the Japanese Derby, let us add yet another pillar of prestige to the Kingdom of Roses."

text_block_list.name: Racing Fan A
text_block_list.text:
And of course, there's Rulership from that elite academy!
Did you see her in that Open race the other day!? An absolute blowout victory!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
I've been advancing my pieces with my sights set on the battle at the peak.
Right now, no one reads this board better than me.

text_block_list.name: Racing Fan B
text_block_list.text: "Since she missed out on the Satsuki Sho, I'm really excited to see what kind of race she'll put on this time~."

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Between the Rose Clan and the academy,
Ruler and Rose have quite the intricate history together, you see.

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: Ah, with Air Groove...? I suppose that's something the fans are eagerly looking forward to as well.

text_block_list.name: Male Student A
text_block_list.text:
Either way,
it's about who stands at the very top of this generation!

text_block_list.name: Male Student B
text_block_list.text: They're all headliners! For real, we might actually get to see a legendary Japanese Derby~!

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: HaaaaaaAAH!!

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: Haah, haah, whew—!
choice_data_list: Lady Rose, this is the final rep!

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Aah!
—Hyaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
My body feels light, and my acceleration has improved.
I can genuinely feel myself peaking.
Does it appear so to you as well?
choice_data_list: Yes, it has exceeded expectations, even.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
I see.
...A victory in the Japanese Derby is extraordinary.
Claiming it would elevate the prestige of our Rose Kingdom immensely.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
I cannot let it slip away.
I must seize it with my own hands.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Oh, thank you for your hard work,
Rose-san, Trainer-san.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: To think I would encounter you at such an hour.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
That monumental showdown—
the Japanese Derby has drawn us together, it seems.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
The excitement is already higher than any normal year. I'm certain
we can create an enormous, powerful circle across the racetrack.
Just thinking about it makes me unable to stand still.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Fully prepared, I see.
Well, I have assembled every card in my hand as well.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Even if my opponents are of top-ranker caliber,
I have no intention of resigning so easily.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Let us make it a fine contest between us.
I look forward to our duel in the Nippon Derby.

text_block_list.name: Pisa & Ruler
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, yes. I'm looking forward to it.
—Ah. The pleasure is mine, Your Majesty.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A dazzling crown reachable only once in a lifetime.
The Umamusume sprint in pursuit of it. Every single one of them—

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Taaaaaaaaah—!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Everyone, without exception,
had been longing for the Japanese Derby.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Haah, haah, haah...
What was... my time—

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Unglaublich!
A final three furlongs in 32.7 seconds—!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: ...Ngh!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Father, Mother.
Please watch over me tomorrow.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Once more, right here,
I shall demonstrate the prestige of my clan!

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
I will create a strong, warm circle of bonds—
one so grand it spills far beyond the racetrack.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: If I am to dominate the Twinkle Series, this is one game I cannot afford to lose.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Today, it is I who shall ascend to the summit.
—Without fail.

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Truly, 'the greatest Derby in history'!
It is finally underway!
